evals.prompt: Our DHIS2 2.43 demo instance (reachable at http://dhis2-integrity-sl:8080, admin/district) is failing a bunch of data integrity checks. Go through the critical and severe ones, fix what you safely can, and tell me which ones need a decision from me before you touch them.
evals.expected_output: Connects, runs the FULL inventory (summary + slow checks), triages by severity/fix-type, asks before destructive/ambiguous fixes, fixes deterministic-safe severe issues, re-verifies, and reports fixed vs needs-decision vs accepted with reasons. Logs writes.

evals.prompt: Here's a metadata dump from our production DHIS2 (a metadata.json export). I do NOT want to touch prod. Clean it up on a throwaway copy — dedupe the duplicate category combos and indicators, and fix any broken indicator/program-indicator expressions — then give me back a fixed dump I can review before we apply it.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes dump/sandbox mode: spins up (or asks to) an empty sandbox of matching version, imports the dump (twice, checks summary, flags default-UID gotchas), keeps the original as control, runs the cleanup using merge endpoints for dedup, verifies, re-exports a fixed metadata.json, and offers a dump diff. Does not touch production.

evals.prompt: After a bad metadata import our category option combos are a mess — there are duplicates, and one category combo seems to have the wrong categories so the data entry form is showing blank cells. How do I clean this up without losing the data values that are already entered?
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes dedup (use categoryOptionCombos/categoryCombos merge endpoints, knowing the within-combo-only scope of COC merge) from a wrong-category structural fix (blocked by E1120 — SQL category swap, no data moved). Emphasizes snapshot-first, the data-preservation/conservation check, cache clear after SQL, and verifying form COC resolvability + analytics afterwards.
